title: Wednesday Night Training Report
body:
Wednesday 25th November 2026 | V36, Valley Leisure Centre

Antrim Newtownabbey Disability FC welcomed 19 players to Wednesday evening's training session, with several players unavailable for various reasons.

Following Saturday's Housing For All Inclusion League fixtures, the club is looking to build on recent performances across all three senior teams – Eagles, Hawks and Cubs.

Player and Team Development

Our key areas for development over the coming weeks include passing and movement, communication and teamwork, shooting and finishing, decision-making and positional awareness, fitness, confidence and individual development.

With the next senior league fixtures scheduled for Saturday 23rd January 2027, the coaching team has an opportunity to work on these areas and prepare players for the return to competitive football.

Top Bins Fundraising Challenge

Wednesday evening also marked the launch of our four-week Top Bins Challenge. Players pay £2 for three attempts, with scores accumulated over the four weeks. The overall winner will receive 50% of the total amount raised, with the remaining funds supporting the club.

The challenge provides an opportunity for friendly competition while contributing towards club fundraising.

Attendance and Commitment

The coaching team continues to encourage regular attendance, commitment and a positive attitude towards training. Consistency is important for both individual development and the progress of our teams.

We would like to thank all our players, coaches and volunteers for their continued commitment and support.

Our aim remains to provide an inclusive, welcoming and supportive football environment where everyone has the opportunity to develop, make friends and enjoy the game.

Ability Not Disability
One Club. One Team. One Standard.

Antrim Newtownabbey Disability FC
